nvd.title: CVE lookup (NVD)
nvd.row_title: NVD API key (shared by the whole system)
nvd.row_hint: This key is used for the CVE lookup of every Vulnerability Scan.
nvd.b1: The Vulnerability Scan looks up CVEs at the NVD by the product and version of each service it finds. This key is shared by every scan in the system.
nvd.b2: Without a key the lookup still works, but NVD allows only 5 requests per 30 seconds, so the system waits about 6.5 seconds between requests and a Vulnerability Scan takes longer.
nvd.b4: A key set on this page takes priority over NVD_API_KEY in the .env file. It is kept in the instance folder, outside the database, and is never sent back to the screen.
nvd.superadmin_only: Only a superadmin can change the key.
nvd.paste_label: Paste the NVD API key (format xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx)
nvd.unset: No key yet · CVE lookups are slower
nvd.confirm_delete: Delete the key set on this page? The system will go back to NVD_API_KEY in the .env file, if there is one.
nvd.msg.bad_format: The key is not in the right format. An NVD key looks like xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx (digits 0-9 and letters a-f). Paste only the key.
nvd.probe.invalid: NVD does not recognise this key. Check that it was copied in full and that you clicked the confirmation link in NVD's email.
nvd.probe.busy: NVD refused the request for now (code {code}). It may be too many requests or the service is busy. Test again later.
nvd.probe.network: Could not reach NVD. Check the internet connection.
nvd.probe.other: NVD answered with an unexpected code {code}.
nvd.probe.no_key: There is no key to test. Paste a key first.
nvd.get_key: No key yet? Request a free one at
nvd.get_key_link: the NVD API key request page
